trickyParts: The first `jj git push` failed with `The working copy is stale (not updated since operation …)` — a concurrent operation from another workspace on the shared repository. `jj workspace update-stale` refreshed the working copy onto a new empty commit above the code commit (the provisioned, untracked .omp/config.yml was dropped from disk with the superseded working-copy commit; it was never part of any commit) and the push then succeeded. No `jj undo`/`op restore`.
The GREEN line label is a plain `if` on LEGION_OMP_PATH into `local omp_source` declared with the other locals — the `local x="$(...)"` masking trap the harness comments warn about is avoided.

The mise failure classifier is the substring `not installed` in mise's captured stderr (matches mise 2026.8.10 and the harness fake); any other text falls to the generic message without the remedy, so a future wording change fails safe (still correct, only without the remedy).
